title: MacCrab Plugin Manifest (v1 — platform-aligned)
description: Schema for the manifest.json file inside a Tier B plugin's install directory. v1 (per plan v4.5) aligns with the platform's TierBManifest.swift — flat fields, no nested capabilities block. The flat-directory plugin format is <plugin-id>/{manifest.json, binary, signature, signing.key.pub}; this schema validates the manifest.json. Per plan v4.5 §3.2.

$schema.description: Optional schema reference for IDE autocomplete.

id.description: Reverse-DNS plugin identifier. Globally unique across the catalog. Matches the platform's PluginManifest.id constraint.

displayName.description: Operator-facing display name. Matches platform's TierBManifest.displayName.

schemaVersion.description: Manifest schema version. v1 == platform-aligned (post v4.5).

description.description: Operator-facing description. Length-capped per plan §11 A8 (prompt-injection surface).

kind.description: Forensic plugin role. collector = snapshots system/app data into structured records; analyzer = cross-references already-collected records to surface patterns. Optional (kind-less v1 manifests still validate); mirrors catalog-entry.json. The app dispatches collectors to the Tier-B IPC runner (TierBIPC, protocolVersion 1); analyzer execution is deferred.

fileReadSubpaths.description: Absolute subpaths the plugin reads. Recursive. Used by SandboxProfileBuilder.swift to populate `(allow file-read* (subpath "..."))` clauses in the generated SBPL profile.

fileWriteSubpaths.description: Absolute subpaths the plugin writes. Recursive. Tier B plugins usually only write into their own vault prefix.

networkConnectAllowlist.description: host:port entries the plugin may connect to. Use `*` for wildcard. Empty array = no network (SandboxProfileBuilder emits `(deny network*)`).

processExecPaths.description: Absolute executable paths the plugin may spawn. Common values: /usr/bin/codesign, /usr/bin/otool for analyzers. Required when allowProcessFork=true.

allowProcessFork.description: When true, allows the plugin to call fork() / posix_spawn(). Required when processExecPaths is non-empty.

machServiceConnects.description: Mach service names the plugin may connect to (XPC services + other system services).
